currentWork.title: FINAL.68 live: GPS weather re-fetch stabilization, persistent last-good forecast, and error handling
currentWork.scope: Owner reported recurring slow/unavailable Today weather after FINAL.65/FINAL.67. Current source contained three confirmed client resilience issues: when only current GPS supplies weather point, small GPS jumps across 0.001-degree weather-key buckets repeatedly restarted in-flight weather views; previous successfully retrieved weather was memory-only and vanished on reload; malformed HTTP200 forecast payload thrown inside .then success handler escaped the same .then's reject handler, causing unhandled rejections and waiting for timeout. Current fix keeps the weather-only current GPS point stable until movement >=2km (not map/user GPS), caches at most six non-current-GPS saved route/office forecasts for same day and <=6h in separate localStorage key, immediately displays previous forecast when refresh is needed, leaves last-good temperature and explicit last-retrieval time/reason/retry visible on failure, catches every fetch/validation rejection, validates current temperature and precipitation arrays. Existing 7s timeout/15s negative cooldown and manual retry retained. No user data migration or raw-device-GPS persistence. No schedule, route, delivery, design-system, schema, engine or paused AN15 changes.
